items.description: Baby (baby template) in a cream onesie with both hands - carry it with attach + the carry clip.

Bride in a long white dress, blonde hair, flower crown.

Pip, hero of The Door: the smallest kid in the village (child build), bright teal hoodie (signature colour, readable at night and at distance), navy shorts, messy dark-brown hair, both hands (they fit the carved handprints). Pair with hold_bar / push_door / lift.

General Thimble: heavy classic body, silver thimble-like top hat, navy general suit with gold tie, mustache, sewing-needle sword.
Giant castle guard at scale 30 (about 150 studs): red tabard-suit, steel helmet, spear.
Stocky ginger bully in a green cap and yellow/green stripes; smug face. Goes with laugh / point clips.
The Grabber, scary default: 11-stud grey giant with long arms, torn clothes, red-ink angry face. Pair with the monster_entrance fx recipe.
The Grabber as a grey-skinned boy 60 years ago (flashback): torn clothes, both hands.
The Grabber, gentle variant (after the twist): same giant body with a soft sad face.
Purple-cardigan grandma (grandma template) with a white bun and glasses; knits in a rocking chair.
Old veteran soldier grandpa: grandpa template, faded blue jacket and flat cap, full white beard.
Groom in a black suit with a red tie, slicked hair.
Short tan kid with a black bob and blue shirt; one of the bully pals.
Short pale kid with a blonde fringe and purple knit; bully pal.
Purple-skinned legend with a bob, green stripes and overalls (asked for a boat).
Legend in a maroon suit and sunglasses (asked for a crown).
Short kid hero in a red sweater and jeans, messy brown hair, both hands visible (hide one with hide: [hand_l_mesh] for the sewn-sleeve look). Signature colour red.
Medieval mom in a teal dress, brown bun; one hand. Works with the sew clip.
Mrs. Hale's husband: grandpa template, navy waistcoat, white beard, both hands; mostly seen asleep hanging upside down (hang_ankle, face sleepy).
Mrs. Abernathy: grey bun, glasses, maroon cardigan, no shoes (lost a boot) - hops and shakes her fist.
Old Mrs. Hale: grandma template, rose cardigan, white bun, glasses, both hands; her rope is tied in a neat bow (production draws the bow).
Tiny newborn (classic body, scale 0.45) with messy brown hair in white; lies on a blanket next to the ticket prop.
Little sister in a pink dress with blonde pigtails; one (right) hand; pair with the cookie prop / eat clip.
Modern bystander: black bob, orange cardigan, jeans.
Teen in a blue hoodie and track pants, spiky black hair.
Old man with a white beard, flat cap, suspenders and plaid trousers.

Village man in a striped blue nightshirt and grey trousers, bald, both hands (the one pulled up at midnight).
Village woman: green dress, black bob, both hands (holds her own rope: hold_rope clip).
Tad, the smallest soldier of the tiny kingdom: child build at 0.9, blue soldier jacket, red bottle-cap helmet (signature red), messy brown hair.
Tam, modern hero: red hoodie, jeans, spiky black hair. Signature colour red.
Castle guard: navy tabard-suit with gold trim, steel helmet, spear in the right hand (pair with the hold clip).
Crowd of castle guards (navy/red suits with gold trim) for wall walks and streets; set path/area per use.
Blue-jacketed foot soldier with a grey helmet (tiny kingdom army).
